$comment: Insufficient scope at run time (specification: basic/authorization): the server SHOULD return 403 + WWW-Authenticate error=insufficient_scope. Step-up (re-authorising for a larger scope) is not implemented; it is handled as needs_auth and the user signs in again.

headers.WWW-Authenticate: Bearer error="insufficient_scope", scope="files:write", resource_metadata="https://mcp.example.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource", error_description="File write permission required for this operation"
